# Regression-catcher fixtures

> **Retired (BLD-1023).** The static-PNG fixture flow that lived here is
> superseded by a live wrapper-fixture flow that re-imposes the BLD-480
> regression in the modern toolchain on every audit run. This directory
> exists only to host this README; no PNG is committed.

## What changed

The previous flow checked in `bld-480-pre-fix.png` — a one-shot capture
generated by `.github/workflows/regression-fixture-capture.yml` against a
pre-fix SHA (`cce2ac1f8…`). That approach failed permanently in the 2026
Node 20 + Playwright Chromium environment: the pre-fix Expo bundle's JS
loaded but React never mounted (BLD-924, BLD-941, BLD-943, BLD-1020).
Repeated re-capture attempts (PR #482 / PR #498) hit the same wall.

The replacement (BLD-1023, originally PR [#483]):

| Component | Path |
|---|---|
| Wrapper component (re-imposes `maxHeight: 200` clamp) | `components/session/summary/__fixtures__/MusclesWorkedCardPreFix.tsx` |
| Dev-only Expo Router layout | `app/__fixtures__/_layout.tsx` |
| Dev-only fixture route (web + `__DEV__` guarded) | `app/__fixtures__/bld-480-prefix.tsx` |
| Playwright capture spec | `e2e/scenarios/completed-workout-prefix.spec.ts` |
| Audit driver wiring | `scripts/daily-audit.sh` |
| Trust-anchor smoke | `scripts/regression-smoke.sh` |

Every daily audit run now:

1. Renders `MusclesWorkedCard` wrapped in the regressed `maxHeight: 200`
   clamp via the dev-only fixture route, on **today's** code/toolchain.
2. Captures a fresh PNG (plus three CVD variants) into
   `.pixelslop/audits/<DATE>/BLD_480_PRE_FIX/`.
3. Feeds the captured PNG into `scripts/regression-smoke.sh`, which calls
   the vision API with the standard audit prompt and asserts the response
   contains at least one term matching the QD#2 canonical regex:

   ```
   crop|truncat|clip|maxHeight|cut off|MusclesWorkedCard|body-figure
   ```

## Why this directory still exists

The audit-bundle uploader and the ux-designer agent intake reference the
`BLD_480_PRE_FIX/` bundle directory by name, and earlier audits ship
sidecar metadata that points operators here. Keeping the README ensures
those breadcrumbs still resolve to a coherent explanation.

If you arrived here from a stale link, see:

- The wrapper component and its freeze contract:
  [`components/session/summary/__fixtures__/MusclesWorkedCardPreFix.tsx`](../../../components/session/summary/__fixtures__/MusclesWorkedCardPreFix.tsx)
- The audit driver: [`scripts/daily-audit.sh`](../../../scripts/daily-audit.sh)
- The trust-anchor smoke: [`scripts/regression-smoke.sh`](../../../scripts/regression-smoke.sh)

## Adding more regression-catchers

To add another defect to the daily smoke:

1. Add a wrapper fixture under
   `components/<area>/__fixtures__/<NameOfRegressionPreFix>.tsx` that
   re-imposes the buggy layout/style around the modern component.
2. Add a dev-only route under `app/__fixtures__/<bld-id>-prefix.tsx`
   guarded with `__DEV__` and `Platform.OS === "web"`.
3. Add a Playwright spec at `e2e/scenarios/<name>-prefix.spec.ts` that
   navigates the route and emits to a new scenario subdir.
4. Extend `scripts/daily-audit.sh` to capture the new spec into a
   separately-named bundle dir, and (optionally) extend
   `scripts/regression-smoke.sh` to run a per-fixture regex on its
   capture.

Refs: BLD-1023 (this migration), BLD-959 (retired static-PNG flow),
BLD-941, BLD-924, BLD-480 (original bug).
